leadText: Georgia's Beartic (Japanese: ラングレーのツンベアー Langley's Tunbear) is the first seen under Georgia's ownership. It is also her main Pokémon.
plainText:
Georgia's Beartic (Japanese: ラングレーのツンベアー Langley's Tunbear) is the first seen under Georgia's ownership. It is also her main Pokémon.

==History==
 
Beartic debuted in Iris and Excadrill Against the Dragon Buster!, where it was sent out by its to battle . During the battle, it took out both and , resulting in victory for Georgia. It was sent out again the next day to battle Excadrill. Even though Excadrill was no longer disobedient towards his Trainer, the battle ended in a draw.

In Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!, it was used to battle 's in the first round of the Club Battle. After taking heavy damage from , it collapsed on the Attaching Pokémon, crushing it with its weight and winning the match.

In Crisis at Ferroseed Research!, Beartic helped clear the moss covering the Ferroseed Research Institute created by the there.

In Jostling for the Junior Cup, Beartic was used to battle 's in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. Despite having a major type advantage and Dragonite disobeying Iris, Beartic was knocked out by one , eliminating Georgia from the tournament.

==Personality and characteristics==
True to its species, Beartic appears to be very powerful. It also is the kind of Pokémon that proudly follows the title of its Trainer, in this case Georgia being a prominent user. Beartic is very loyal to its Trainer and takes great pride in battling any Pokémon, even one against which it is at a disadvantage. Beartic also seems to be quite persistent, such as when it kept on eliminating the rapidly growing moss coming from the despite being tired from using multiple s.
